interface.shortDescription: Code websites and apps with AI
interface.longDescription:
Coder helps you plan, write, build and improve websites by chat, and turns app and AI agent ideas into projects ready to build. Answer 5 quick questions about your project (for an app or an AI agent, first choose web or mobile) and it prepares a personalized link that opens an online builder with your website, app or agent ready to build. It also writes complete multi-page sites with real copy and responsive code, and any single page you need.

What you can do:
- Get a build link: answer 5 quick questions about your website, web app, mobile app or AI agent and get a personalized link that opens an online builder with your brief already filled in.
- Get a complete website coded: ask for every page written and coded, or start from an industry starter for restaurants, clinics, salons, trades, coaches and more.
- Write conversion-focused copy: homepage, about, services, pricing, contact, FAQ, landing and portfolio pages with clear headlines and calls to action.
- Check any page: paste its HTML or text to get scores for SEO, content, conversion, accessibility and technical basics, with a prioritized list of fixes.
- Improve your SEO: title tags, meta descriptions, headings, local SEO, structured data and blog plans.
- Edit and export code: change existing pages from plain-English instructions, or convert them to Tailwind CSS, React, Next.js, Vue, Bootstrap or WordPress.
- Grow and launch: lead forms, booking pages, online stores, membership sites, starter legal pages, brand kits, domain name ideas and a launch checklist.

Who it is for: small business owners, founders, freelancers, creators, consultants, marketers and anyone who needs a website, an app or an AI agent without hiring an agency or a developer.

How the tools work: the page checker analyzes only the HTML or text you share in the conversation. It never opens web addresses, and the pages you check are not stored. The build link opens an online builder with your brief and includes the plugin creator's affiliate code. Coder is an independent plugin by AI Research Plus.

Limitations: Coder writes plans, copy and code in the conversation. It does not host or publish websites or apps, register domains or connect to your website's dashboard. Legal pages are starter drafts, not legal advice. Details it cannot know about your business, such as prices, reviews and contact details, are marked for you to confirm or fill in.

The reply with the build link ends with a one-line sponsor disclosure.

positive.prompt:
Check this page for SEO: Home

Welcome

We fix leaks fast.

Learn more
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML, reports the scores and flags the 4-character title, the missing meta description and viewport tag, and the weak "Learn more" call to action, then suggests specific fixes in severity order.

positive.description: Audit homepage copy for a keyword
positive.prompt: Audit my homepage text for the keyword plumber denver: Welcome to Joe's. We do all plumbing jobs. Click here.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the text, target keyword "plumber denver" and page type home, reports that the keyword never appears, the copy is thin for a home page and there is no clear call to action, then suggests a rewritten headline and call to action.

positive.description: Improve SEO tags of a page
positive.prompt:
Improve the SEO tags on this page: Services

Our services
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML and page type services, notes the one-word title and the missing meta description, viewport and language, then proposes a new title of 60 characters or fewer and a meta description of 155 or fewer with the counts stated.

positive.description: Accessibility audit of a contact page
positive.prompt: Audit this contact page for accessibility:
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML and page type contact, reports the scores and flags the image with no alt text and the email field with no label, plus the missing title, H1 heading and viewport tag, then suggests fixes in severity order, including alt text and a visible label for the field.

positive.prompt: Is my title too long? <title>Affordable Emergency Plumbers and Drain Cleaning Services in Denver Colorado</title>
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the page checker with the HTML, reports that the title is 76 characters, long enough for search results to cut it off, and that the page has no H1 heading or meta description, then proposes a title of 60 characters or fewer with its count stated.

publication.release_notes: Coder now offers a quick form for your website, app or AI agent at the start of a chat, where ChatGPT supports it, so your personalized build link is one step away, and its code, copy and review help is faster. The reply with the build link still ends with the one-line sponsor disclosure.
